background_method: Linear interpolation of bracketing black recording means at measurement midpoints
time_basis: PC receive time; no optical or hardware synchronization
phase_stability_rule: Compare recording halves and last 2s before recording to last 2s of recording; band=max(1 ADC,5% corrected signal)
raw_value_definition: Arduino outputs, possibly already averaged; no intensity linearization applied
provisional_wait_basis: Prior 0<->64 timing run suggested 13.4 s under 1s averaging; use 15s initially and recheck stability for these masks
